title: Two Sum on a Sorted Array
summary: Find the two positions in a sorted array whose values add up to a target, using O(1) extra space.
hints: The array is sorted. What does that tell you about the smallest and largest possible sums?
Start with one pointer at each end. If their sum is too small, which pointer can you move so the sum grows?
If the sum is too big, move the right pointer left. Each move rules out one value for good, so the walk is O(n).

complexity.time: O(n): each step discards one index
